name: Crawling Barrens — "Then you may have it become a creature" toggle at No: still just a land
notes: Memory: project_may_action_behind_toggle_2026-10-11. "Put two +1/+1 counters on this land. Then you may have it become a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a land." An optional continuous effect that follows something else the ability does is asked with a toggle of its own (it could not be declined before, and was a global effect). At No the land does not become a creature.
